description:
An adjuster is closing an account on the ninth floor this afternoon. A year in arrears. She wants somebody in the corridor while she does it.

Not to come in. Not to be introduced. Not to intervene.

"He won't take it well and it won't last long."

Closing an account is four things. The cover ends. The chrome in him reverts to Halcyon and is scheduled for recovery. The household comes off the water and power book at the end of the month. The file goes into run-off.

None of that happens this afternoon. This afternoon he's only told.

fail_on.desc: Somebody looked straight at you. An adjuster who's remembered isn't an adjuster.
It reached a camera. Halcyon can settle a great many things, but not a recording.

name: Adjuster

objectives.desc: Get up to the ninth floor and take the corridor.
emotes: {who} finds a doorway with a good angle on the corridor and stops being a person in a corridor.
{who} hears the first two minutes go quite well, which is the part nobody warns you about.

objectives.desc: Pull the account record while the adjuster is inside.
emotes: {who} works the panel with the sound of a conversation changing register on the other side of a wall.
{who} gets the record, and reads the date the account went into arrears, and does the arithmetic without meaning to.
